title: AFTERMATH
lyrics:
[HOOK]
The aftermath is all I see.
The aftermath is the death of me.
The aftermath is where I stand.
The aftermath is the blood on my hands.
[VERSE 1]
I've been walking through the wreckage of the war I used to wage.
Every enemy is gone now, but I'm still trapped inside the cage.
The saxophone is playing as the smoke begins to clear.
And the only thing that's left me is the silence and the fear.
The aftermath is all I see. The aftermath is the death of me.
I built this devastation with the fury and the flame.
And now I'm standing in the aftermath with nothing but the shame.
[VERSE 2]
I've been counting all the bodies that I buried on the way.
Some were enemies, some were friends, some were versions of yesterday.
The glitch is in the ground now, and the glitch is in the air.
And the only thing I'm breathing is the ghost of my despair.
The aftermath is where I stand. The aftermath is the blood on my hands.
I don't know who I am without the fight, don't know who I am without the rage.
I just know the war is over, and I'm still trapped inside the cage.
[VERSE 3]
I've been staring at the sunrise through the smoke and through the dust.
And the only thing I'm feeling is the absence of the trust.
The saxophone is crying as the city starts to fade.
And the only thing that's left me is the aftermath I made.
The aftermath is all I see. The aftermath is the death of me.
I don't want the reconstruction, I don't want the second try.
I just want to stand in the ruins and finally say goodbye.
[VERSE 4]
So this is for the aftermath, for the ash, for the bone.
For the ones who fought the battle and are left here all alone.
I'm not asking for the healing, I'm not begging for the peace.
I'm just standing in the wreckage and I'm finally released.
The aftermath is where I stand. The aftermath is the blood on my hands.
The aftermath is the end of the war. The aftermath is what I've been fighting for.
And the aftermath is quiet. The aftermath is still.
The aftermath is the only place where I can finally feel.

lyrics:

I'm drifting in a haze between the real and the fake
A waking dream where nothing stays, and nothing breaks
I saw your face once in the corner of my eye
But when I turned around, you were just a passerby
The sun is warm but distant. The air is thick and sweet.
I'm chasing shadows down a long and empty street.

A melody that promises there's something waiting there

I'm reaching for a hand that was never really there.
Afternoon of a faun. Lost inside the air.
[VERSE 2]
My father told me once that dreams were for the weak
But he spent his whole life chasing something he could never reach
So maybe I'm the same. Maybe I'm his son.
A creature made of longing. A race that's never won.
But the afternoon is gentle. It doesn't ask for much.
Just a moment of surrender. Just a soft and quiet touch.
So I'll float into the music. I'll let the hours slide.
The faun was always dreaming. And maybe so am I.
[PRE-CHORUS]
And the music keeps on playing like a vapor in the air
A melody that promises there's something waiting there
I'm half-awake and half-asleep and fully in between
The afternoon is stretching out into a endless scene
[CHORUS]
Afternoon of a faun.
Drifting in the haze where the edges are gone.
I'm reaching for a hand that was never really there.
Afternoon of a faun. Lost inside the air.
[BRIDGE]

title: AGAINST THE CLOCK
lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
Yeah... uh... the seconds tick, the minutes slip, the hours drip like sand through a broken

I'm racing through the days, trying to raise the dead with a phrase, but the haze just
expands... (haze just expands)
Every moment that I waste is a face I can't replace, a taste of the past that's fading fast...
(fading fast)
The clock is on my back, a permanent attack, a fact I can't outlast, a shadow that's been
cast... (shadow that's been cast)
I'm sprinting through the graveyard while the headstones blur to gray, a relay race I'm
losing every day... (losing every day)
But I keep running anyway, 'cause the running is the only way to keep the ghosts at
bay... (ghosts at bay)
[VERSE 2]
The calendar is cruel, a tool that steals the fuel from the fire of the youth... (fire of the youth)
Every birthday is a reminder that the finder of the truth is a sleuth with a broken tooth...
(broken tooth)
I'm counting down the hours while the flowers on the graves begin to wilt and decay...
(wilt and decay)
The clock is not a friend, it's the end of every trend, a bend in the road that takes them
all away... (takes them all away)
I'm chasing down the seconds, but the seconds are a weapon that I'll never learn to
wield... (learn to wield)
The future is a battlefield where the past is never healed, just concealed and revealed...
(concealed and revealed)
[VERSE 3]
I flip the hourglass but the glass is full of ash from the bodies that I've burned... (bodies that I've burned)
Every grain is a name that I couldn't keep tame, a flame that never returned... (never returned)
I'm wrestling with time, trying to climb up the line, but the line is a vine that keeps
slipping through my grip... (slipping through my grip)
The clock is a thief, a brief relief from the grief, a motif that I'll never outstrip... (never outstrip)
I'm screaming at the sky, asking why the minutes multiply into a mountain I can't scale...
[mountain I can't scale]
But the answer never comes, just the drums of the clock as it nails another coffin without
fail... (coffin without fail)
[VERSE 4]
So I'll race until I drop, never stop, never let the ticking beat me into the ground... (beat me into the ground)
Every second is a blessing, a lesson in the pressing of the love that I've found... (love that I've found)
In the chaos of the race, I embrace the pace, the chase of the memory I can't erase...
[memory I can't erase]
The clock can keep on ticking, I'll be kicking and I'm sticking to the rhythm of the
grace... (rhythm of the grace)
So let the hours run, I've already won the war against the dark by keeping every spark
alive inside my chest... (alive inside my chest)
The clock can take the rest, but the best of what I've known is my own, and I'll never let
it rest... (never let it rest)
[OUTRO]
Against the clock.
Tick... tick... gone.
EXCAVATIONPRO.

The key is emotional and passionate, not "hard" in the sense of aggressive or screaming. It's that
melodic, radio-ready rock with a heavy edge, where the vocals carry a deep, relatable ache.
He's repeating the same specs he gave before: radio-ready, social-media sharp, unique edge,
relatable. But now he's tying it to a concrete musical reference. The challenge is to translate the
lyrical themes we've been working with—isolation, betrayal, being a "defective product,"
existential exhaustion—into a structure that perfectly fits those bands' formulas.
I need to dissect what makes those bands' songs work. It's typically: a clean, melancholic guitar
intro or a simple, driving riff. A first verse that's direct and storytelling, setting up the emotional
wound. A pre-chorus that lifts the tension, usually melodically and lyrically. Then a huge,
anthemic, melodic chorus—this is the most important part. It has to be singable, emotionally
resonant, and feel like a release. A second verse that deepens the theme. Another pre-chorus and
chorus. A bridge that's often more reflective or builds to a final climax, and a final chorus that
might be slightly stripped back or have added vocal intensity.
The lyrics need to be simple, universal, and visceral. No complex metaphors. "It's Been Awhile"
works because "It's been a while since I could hold my head up high" is a line everyone gets
immediately. "Here Without You" is a straightforward, aching confession. "Bad Girlfriend" is
catchy, direct, and a bit sleazy.
"Can't Kill Me Twice," and "Someday's Never Coming"—and completely re-sculpt them into this
Staind/3 Doors Down mold. The choruses need to be huge, melodic, and built for a crowd to sing
along. The verses need to be more grounded and less poetic. The bridges should offer a moment
of reflection before the final emotional payoff.

lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
The Elect One stood at the mouth of the deep
Where the dark lords writhed in a permanent sleep
He spoke a single word that the void understood
The chains of the abyss turned from iron to wood
To stone. To silence. To a seal without key.
The ones who taught rebellion now have no mouth to plea.
The angels of the pit were dragged into the dark
Their wings turned to lead. Their eyes lost their spark.
The voice said "Look. Remember. Write it in the flame.
The deep is the prison. The deep is the name."
[INSTRUMENTAL]
[VERSE 2]
The seal was carved with a finger of light
It said "No return. No end to the night."
The ones who built their kingdoms on the suffering of the just
Are now the foundation of the abyss's rust.
No court will hear their case. No angel will descend.
The binding of the deep is a sentence without end.
The lesson is the closure. The lesson is the lock.
The guide said "Write it down. Let the ages feel the shock.
The dark lords are bound. The seal is the rock."
[INSTRUMENTAL]
[OUTRO]
The deep is sealed. The dark lords are bound. The Elect One reigns.
No key. No door. No escape.
The binding is eternal.
EXCAVATIONPRO.

title: THE BLESSING AFTER THE FLOOD
lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
The waters pulled back and the ground began to dry
The first green shoot reached up toward the sky
Not a blade of grass that the flood had swept away
But something new. Something born on the first new day.
The vow was spoken from the throne above the storm
"The earth will not be drowned again. The seed will keep its form.
As long as the ground remains, the harvest will appear.
The cold will have its season. The warmth will dry the tear."
The blessing fell like sunlight on the shoulders of the few
Who walked out of the vessel into earth made new.
They planted the first field with their hands still wet.
A covenant of soil. A promise and a debt.
[INSTRUMENTAL]
[VERSE 2]
The fruit of the ground became the answer to the grief
The olive and the vine gave a permanent relief
The days began to lengthen. The nights began to warm.
The world was not a ruin. It was waiting to transform.
The ones who had been hidden from the fury of the tide
Walked into the open with the promise as their guide.
They built the first stone altar from the river's polished rock.
They thanked the unseen hand that had opened up the lock.
And the lesson was eternal for the ones who understood.
The flood was not the ending. The flood was just the wood
That carried them across the chaos to a shore they'd never seen.
The blessing after the flood is the deepest kind of clean.
[INSTRUMENTAL]
[OUTRO]
The waters receded.
The seed was planted.
The blessing holds.
EXCAVATIONPRO.

title: THE BLESSING AND THE CURSE
lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
There's a word being whispered from beyond the eastern gate
Not for all the sleeping ones. But for the ones who wait.
It says the earth will testify against the deeds of men.
The soil remembers everything. It's just a question of when.
A blessing for the chosen. A curse upon the proud.
The mountains will proclaim it. The rivers will sing it loud.
[INSTRUMENTAL]
[VERSE 2]
The just will be protected when the earth begins to shake.
Not by walls of stone. But by the promise that they make.
The unjust will be scattered like the chaff before the wind.
No hand will stop the harvest. No apology will mend.
The watchers saw it coming from the summit of the hill.
They wrote it in the tablets. They're writing it still.
The book is being opened. The pages are alive.
The words are for the ones who choose to see and not just thrive.
So take the blessing. Wear the warning like a second skin.
The reckoning is ancient. And it's about to begin.
[INSTRUMENTAL]
[OUTRO]
The earth remembers.
The stars are watching.
The word is spoken.
Blessing and curse. Both are true.
EXCAVATIONPRO.

title: THE BOOK OF DESTRUCTION
lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
The book was opened to the page where your name should be.
The ink was missing. The space was empty. The line was free.
You thought your deeds were written in the ledgers of the sky.
You thought your power meant your name would never die.
But the pen of the scribe doesn't tremble. The ink doesn't fade.
The names of the wicked are a temporary shade.
The book of destruction is the record of the lost.
The ones who never counted up the mercy or the cost.
The voice said "Write it down. Let the blotting be complete.
The wicked are not written. The wicked face defeat."
[INSTRUMENTAL]
[VERSE 2]
No angel will remember the syllable you spoke.
No witness will rise up for the promises you broke.
The name you carved in monuments is weathered and is worn.
The memory of the wicked is a fleeting, fading thorn.
But the righteous are the permanent. The righteous are the etched.
Their names are in the stone that the ages never wretched.
The book of destruction is the shadow of the just.
The wicked are the vapor. The wicked are the dust.
The voice said "Write it down. Let the ages feel the weight.
The wicked are forgotten. The wicked are too late."
[INSTRUMENTAL]
[OUTRO]
Blotted... blotted... gone.
EXCAVATIONPRO.

title: THE BOOK OF LIFE
lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
The pen is moving. The ink is permanent.
The names of the righteous are carved in the firmament.
No hand can erase them. No tyrant can scratch the stone.
The ones who walked in mercy are the ones the book has known.
But the wicked are a vapor. A shadow on the page.
Their names are not recorded. They vanish with the age.
Don't trade your inheritance for a temporary throne.
Don't sell your soul for a kingdom made of bone.
The voice said "Write it down. Let the record be complete.
The righteous are the written. The wicked face defeat."
[CHORUS]
Written in the book where the light never fades
Names of the faithful in eternal cascades
The wicked have no memory. The righteous have the flame.
Hold on through the darkness. Hold on through the pain.
Written. Written. The book of life is written.
[VERSE 2]
The sons of the light will inherit the dawn.
The sons of the shadow will wish they were never born.
The Elect One reads the ledger with eyes that never close.
He knows the ones who gave the water. He knows the ones who chose
The left-hand path. The right-hand lie.
The middle road of mercy that the faithful occupy.
So walk with the written. Let your name be sealed in fire.
The book of life is open. The judgment is the pyre.
The voice said "Write it down. Let the warning be the way.
The righteous are recorded. The wicked are the prey."
[CHORUS]
Written in the book where the light never fades
Names of the faithful in eternal cascades
The wicked have no memory. The righteous have the flame.
Hold on through the darkness. Hold on through the pain.
Written. Written. The book of life is written.
[OUTRO]
Your name is written.
Don't let it fade.

title: THE BOOK OF LIGHT
lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
The scribe unrolled the parchment where the stars themselves are named
Every single luminary that the Ancient One had framed
The sun and moon gave answer for the days they failed to rise
The wandering stars were silent, with no truth within their lies
The book of light was opened, every orbit was assessed
The ones who kept their course were sealed and permanently blessed
But the stars that broke the covenant, that fled their given time
Were blotted from the register with an unrelenting rhyme
The voice said "Look. Remember. Write down what you see.
The book of light is opened. The light is the decree."
[INSTRUMENTAL]
[VERSE 2]
The righteous are inscribed with an everlasting pen
Their names are in the ledger, they will never fade again
The light that they reflected in the shadow of the earth
Is now their own possession, is now their second birth
The ones who kept the faith when the darkness pressed them hard
Are written in the book with an unremovable regard
No power can erase them, no tyrant strike them through
The book of light is sealed with the oath of the True
The lesson is the record, the lesson is the page
The guide said "Write it down, let the light assuage
The righteous shine forever, the condemned are in the cage."
[INSTRUMENTAL]
[OUTRO]
The book is closed. The light is measured. The righteous are written.
The stars that fell are blotted out.
The Luminaries are judged.

title: THE BOOKS OF THE RECORD
lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
I wrote the final sentence on the tablet made of stone
The ink was made of memory. The seal was made of bone.
The watchers have been named and their judgment has been set.
The mountains have been measured. The gulf is fixed in debt.
The winds have been released and the stars have felt the chain.
The tour of the cosmos was not given in vain.
The record of the fallen is complete in every part.
The books are being shut now. The sealing is the art.
The voice said "You have witnessed. You have written what you saw.
Now let the books be closed. Let the testimony be law."
[INSTRUMENTAL]
[VERSE 2]
I handed back the pen that I was given in the dream.
I watched the books be carried to the throne above the stream
Of fire that encircles the Ancient One in white.
The record was accepted in the chamber of the light.
The books will not be opened till the final day arrives.
But every word is living. Every syllable survives.
The just will read the promise. The unjust read the doom.
The books are not forgotten in the archives of the room.
The lesson is the record. The lesson is the seal.
The witness has spoken. The witness is real.
The guide said "Your portion of the vision is complete.
Now rest. The books are shut. The record is replete."
[INSTRUMENTAL]
[OUTRO]
The books are sealed. The record stands. The witness rests.
The testimony is complete.
The first portion is finished.

lyrics:
[INTRO]
Yeah. I've been holding it together for years. Decades. A lifetime.
The cracks were always there. But I kept patching them. Kept standing.
Until the day I couldn't. The day the will just... snapped.
This is Chapter Four. This is the break.

title: THE BURNING
lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
I feel the burning in my chest again.
The fire that the world can't comprehend.
It starts in the gut, it spreads to the bone.
It's the only thing I've ever called my own.
[VERSE 2]
They tried to drown it, tried to smother the flame.
They threw their water, but it only fed the same
Inferno that I carry like a curse and a crown.
The burning keeps me standing when they want me down.
[VERSE 3]
The world is cold, but I am not.
I am the fever that they forgot.
Every scar is a match, every wound is a spark.
The burning is the light I keep in the dark.
[VERSE 4]
So let it burn. Let it rage. Let it tear through the night.
I am not the one who goes quietly into the light.
The burning is my anthem, my battle, my breath.
It started in my chest, and it won't stop until death.

title: THE CAGE
lyrics:
[HOOK]
The cage is closed. The cage is locked.
The cage is everything I've ever fought.
The cage is built from all my lies.
The cage is looking through my eyes.
[VERSE 1]
I've been pacing in this prison that I built with my own hands.
Every bar's a memory, every lock's a reprimand.
The accordion is playing as the walls begin to close.
And the only thing I'm breathing is the fear that only grows.
The cage is closed. The cage is locked. The cage is everything I've ever fought.
I built this cage from silence, built it from the shame.
And now the cage is all I am, and the cage is all the same.
[VERSE 2]
I've been screaming at the ceiling, but the ceiling's made of glass.
And the only thing I see above is everything that's passed.
The glitch is in the floorboards, and the glitch is in the door.
And the only thing I'm certain of is I can't take no more.
The cage is built from all my lies. The cage is looking through my eyes.
I've been trying to find the exit, trying to find the key.
But the key is in the mirror, and the mirror's looking back at me.
[VERSE 3]
I've been watching all the shadows dance across the iron bars.
And the only thing I'm certain of is I've been here too long.
The accordion is laughing as the carnival begins.
And the only thing that's left me is the cage and all my sins.
The cage is closed. The cage is locked. The cage is everything I've ever fought.
I don't know who the prisoner is, I don't know who's to blame.
I just know the cage is burning, and I'm standing in the flame.
[VERSE 4]
So this is for the cages, for the bars, for the pain.
For the ones who built a prison and forgot to make a chain.
I'm not asking for the freedom, I'm not begging for the light.
I'm just breaking every bar with a fury and a fight.
The cage is closed. The cage is locked. The cage is everything I've ever fought.
The cage is built from all my lies. The cage is looking through my eyes.
And I'm tearing down the walls now, I'm tearing down the door.
The cage is finally breaking. And I'm not the cage no more.

lyrics:

The call goes out to the ones who were marked before the flood

The chosen speak the truth in the middle of the lie

They stand at the gates where the wicked stumble through
They hold the lantern. They hold the view.
The witness is not given to the ones who seek their fame.
It's given to the silent. It's given to the flame
That burns in the heart of the ones who never bowed.
The call is the signal. The call is the cloud.
The voice said "Write it down. Let the record be the sign.
The chosen are the witnesses. The chosen are the line."

Cho-sen... cho-sen... rise.

lyrics:

title: THE CELESTIAL OATH
lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
The sun swore an oath with its rising and its fall
It speaks against the wicked with no voice at all.
The moon took the vow with its phases and its light
It testifies in silence through the watches of the night.
The stars in their legions all answer to the call
They swear by the Ancient One who made them stand tall.
No luminary wavers. No celestial breaks rank.
The ones who walk in darkness have the heavens to thank
For the witness that condemns them. For the light they refused.
The voice said "Look. Remember. Every oath is infused."
[INSTRUMENTAL]
[VERSE 2]
The wicked cannot hide from the testimony of the sky
The sun sees every deed with its unrelenting eye.
The moon records the secrets that are whispered in the dark
The stars will bear the witness with an everlasting spark.
The oath was sworn in heaven before the earth was formed
The ones who break the covenant are broken and deformed.
The righteous keep the rhythm. They know the oath is true.
The wicked try to flee but the heavens always knew.
The lesson is the witness. The lesson is the vow.

lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
The ground split open where the two paths finally meet
The righteous on the mountain. The wicked in the heat.
Between them now a chasm that no one can ever cross
No bridge of second chances. No ladder for the loss.
The ones who showed no mercy now beg for just a glance
But the gap is fixed forever. They wasted every chance.
The Elect One spoke the word and the valley tore apart
The line was drawn in fire between the soul and the heart.
The voice said "Look. Remember. Write down what you see.
The chasm is the judgment. The chasm is the decree."
[INSTRUMENTAL]
[VERSE 2]
The righteous shine like stars in the garden of the throne
They drink from living water. They never thirst alone.
But the wicked scream in echoes from the bottom of the deep
No hand will ever reach them. No one will ever weep.
They had their days of power. They had their days of gold.
They spent them crushing spirits. Now the story's told.
The ones who mocked the warning now understand too late
The chasm is the answer. The chasm is the fate.
The lesson is the distance. The lesson is the fall.
The guide said "Write it down. Let the record stand for all.
The chasm is eternal. The chasm is the wall."

[OUTRO]

No crossing. No return.
The separation is eternal.

title: THE CHILDREN OF THE STARS
lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
They looked down from the peak and saw the daughters of the land

One" feels right. I'll go with "The Elect One" as it's the focal point.
HARD VERSE -> INSTRUMENTAL DUBSTEP CHORUS -> OUTRO.
For the verses, I need to condense the chapter's imagery. Chapter 41 shows the secrets of the
heavens, the courses of the luminaries, the thunder and lightning, and the ultimate destiny of both
the just and the unjust. The lesson is that there is a hidden order, and an Elect One is at the center

can focus on the Elect One, the judgment of the powerful, and the trembling of the kings. The
lyrics need to be cryptic but human-relatable, using our signature style.
The outro should seal this new section of the Codex. This chapter is a doorway to the deeper
parables. I'll note that in the outro—"The Parables begin." This signals the narrative progression
within the album itself.
The keys to every age. The paths to every living.

[VERSE 1]
Woe to the ones who built their kingdoms on the bones of the weak
Woe to the ones who took the bread from the mouths of the meek.
The day of reckoning is not a distant, quiet hum.
It's the grinding of the gears. It's the beating of the drum.
The wicked will not rest. Their gold will turn to rust.
Their names will be erased. Their monuments to dust.
Don't think the silence is the absence of the law.
The judgment is a wave. The judgment is a claw.
The voice said "Write it down. Let the woe be complete.
The wicked have no refuge. The wicked face defeat."
[KENZIE JADE GLITCHED CHORUS]
[VERSE 2]
No peace for the oppressors. No sleep for the cruel.
The ones who used their power as a weapon and a tool
Will find their beds are serpents. Their drink is liquid flame.
The judgment has no mercy. The judgment has no name.
The righteous will look down from the safety of the light.
They'll see the wicked scattered in the terror of the night.
Don't trade your soul for a temporary throne.
The woe is everlasting. The woe is all alone.
The voice said "Write it down. Let the ages feel the weight.
The final woe is spoken. The wicked are too late."
[KENZIE JADE GLITCHED CHORUS]
[OUTRO]
Woe... woe... no peace... woe.
EXCAVATIONPRO.

title: THE FIRE OF THE SUN
lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
They showed me the furnace where the sun draws its flame
Not a random burning. Not a wandering game.
It rises and it sets by a command that was given
Before the first morning. Before the first living.
The winds of the south carry heat to its face.
The winds of the north keep it steady in space.
I saw the chariots that carry the light
Across the vault of heaven. Across the dome of night.
No hand touches the wheel. No driver holds the rein.
The sun just knows its road. The sun just knows its lane.
The voice said "Look. Remember. Write down what you see.
The fire of the sun is a fire of decree."
[INSTRUMENTAL]
[VERSE 2]
The moon has its own fire. A different kind of flame.
It waxes and it wanes. It calls the months by name.
It borrows from the sun and it gives back to the tide.
It measures out the seasons. It never tries to hide.
The stars in their courses are a disciplined array.
Not a single one can wander. Not a single one can stray.
They have captains and commanders. They have watches of the night.
They report to the throne in the language of the light.
I asked about the shadows where the wandering ones are thrown.
And they pointed to the prison where the fire has never grown.
The lesson is the order. The lesson is the law.
The luminaries follow the Ancient One in awe.
[INSTRUMENTAL]
[OUTRO]
The sun keeps its course. The moon knows its time. The stars hold their watch.
The fire is the order. The order is the fire.
EXCAVATIONPRO.

title: THE FLATLINE
lyrics:
[INTRO]
Yeah. The fire's out. The pain is gone. The anger faded.
And now there's just... nothing.
They don't tell you that surviving feels like dying slower.
This is the Hollow Codex. Chapter One. The Flatline.
EXCAVATIONPRO.

[VERSE 1]
I used to burn with a fire that could swallow the sky... (swallow the sky)
Every wound was a reason, every loss was a why... (was a why)
But the fire burned out and the ashes went cold... (ashes went cold)
Now I'm standing in the ruins of a story untold... (story untold)
The flatline hums in the back of my mind... (back of my mind)
A quiet little signal that I'm running out of time... (out of time)
Not to die, just to feel, just to care, just to be... (just to be)
The flatline is the numbness that replaced the old me... (replaced the old me)

[VERSE 2]
I remember the rage like a distant old friend... (distant old friend)
I remember the grief that refused to end... (refused to end)
But the rage and the grief finally wore themselves thin... (wore themselves thin)
And left behind nothing but a permanent grin... (permanent grin)
Not of joy, not of peace, just the absence of ache... (absence of ache)
The flatline is the stillness that the healing can't shake... (healing can't shake)
I'm not sad, I'm not happy, I'm not anything at all... (anything at all)
The flatline is the answer to the rise and the fall... (rise and the fall)

[VERSE 3]
They ask me how I'm doing and I say I'm doing fine... (say I'm doing fine)
But fine is just the flatline in a well-rehearsed line... (well-rehearsed line)
I used to feel the weight of every single soul I saved... (single soul I saved)
Now I can't even feel the pulse inside my own veins... (inside my own veins)
The world is on fire and I'm staring at the screen... (staring at the screen)
Watching cities crumble with a quiet, calm serene... (quiet, calm serene)
The flatline isn't peace, it's the absence of the war... (absence of the war)
It's the hollow that remains when you don't care anymore... (don't care anymore)

[VERSE 4]
But somewhere in the stillness there's a flicker of a spark... (flicker of a spark)
Not a flame, not a fire, just a glow in the dark... (glow in the dark)
It doesn't promise healing, it doesn't promise light... (doesn't promise light)
It just says I'm still breathing through the endless night... (endless night)
The flatline may be home but it doesn't have to be... (doesn't have to be)
The grave that I was digging for the hollow part of me... (hollow part of me)
I'm still here, I'm still standing, I'm still drawing breath... (still drawing breath)
The flatline is a chapter, not the permanent death... (permanent death)

[OUTRO]
The flatline.

title: THE FLOCK
album: BORN INTO THIS, I AM NOT THIS
lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
They move as one, a swarm with a thousand eyes
Watching every step, feeding on the lows and highs
I'm a target in the light, a ghost in the dark
Every whispered judgment leaves a permanent mark
They want my attention, they want my soul
Trading real connection for a fleeting scroll
[VERSE 2]
I see them circle, the faces without a core
They tear you down just to ask what you're crying for
A million voices shouting what I should be
But the silence inside is the only thing that's free
They call it community, I call it the cost
A death by a thousand cuts in the flock that I lost
[VERSE 3]
I tried to walk away, but the wires are in my skin
They make you feel alone if you don't let them in
But their warmth is a transaction, their love is a trade
You're a product they consume until the memory fades
I'm not a number, I'm not a name on a screen
I'm a human being in a world that's obscene
[VERSE 4]
So I'm breaking from the flock, tearing out the thread
Choosing my own silence over the words that they spread
They can have their noise, their empty, hungry cries
[OUTRO]
The flock moves on, but I'm not in the swarm.
I was born into this. I am not this.
EXCAVATIONPRO.

title: THE FLOOD
lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
The first drop fell before the warning was complete.
The sky split open. The earth began to weep.
They laughed at the builder. They mocked the wooden frame.
Then the water took their voices. It took every single name.
Forty days of darkness. Forty nights of roar.
Every mountain disappeared. Every landmark from before.
The ark was just a speck upon the fury of the deep.
The only thing that floated on the promises we keep.
We sent the bird out once. It came back with the wet.
We sent the bird again. It brought the olive branch. A debt.
A sign that somewhere dry land waited for the few.
The flood was never punishment. It was just a truth we knew.
[INSTRUMENTAL]
[VERSE 2]
We stepped onto the mountain when the waters pulled away.
The mud was thick. The silence had a lot to say.
We built a stone altar from the wreckage and the bone.
The first thing that we offered was the thanks we'd always known.
Then the sign appeared across the shoulder of the sky.
Seven colors woven. A question and reply.
It said the waters won't return to drown the world again.
But the flood still comes in other forms for women and for men.
So remember what was saved. Remember what was lost.
The bow across the heavens is a permanent reminder of the cost.
[INSTRUMENTAL]
[OUTRO]
The waters receded.
The promise was made.
The sign still hangs.
EXCAVATIONPRO.

title: THE FLOOD DECREE
lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
The word went out from the throne where the Ancient One sits
"Go cleanse the earth of the corruption and the pits
That the fallen ones have dug with their forbidden hands
Wash the blood from the soil. Wash the sin from the lands."
The first one was sent to the son of the dawn
"Bind him hand and foot. Let his power be withdrawn.
Cast him into the darkness where the light cannot reach.
Cover him with stones. Let the desert be his beach."
The second one was sent to the children of the plague
"The giants are to fall. Their kingdom is to fade.
Let their own swords find the flesh of their kin.
Let them tear each other. Let the cleansing begin."
[INSTRUMENTAL]
[VERSE 2]
The third one was sent with the vessel and the plan
"Build it from the wood. Seal it with your hand.
The flood is coming like a verdict from the sky.
Every living thing that breathes the wrong will die."
The rains began to fall from the windows of the deep.
The mountains disappeared. The valleys went to sleep.
The ark was just a speck on the fury of the tide.
But inside it held the promise that the earth would not be denied.
The decree was not for vengeance. The decree was not for hate.
It was the only way to cleanse the corrupted state.
The flood was not the end. It was the beginning of the clean.
The waters would recede. The earth would turn green.
[INSTRUMENTAL]
[OUTRO]
The verdict is delivered.
The flood is set in motion.
The cleansing has begun.
EXCAVATIONPRO.

title: THE FOUR FACES OF THE THRONE
lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
I saw four standing where the light begins to bend
Not in rotation. Not in shift. Their service doesn't end.
The first one lifts his voice to bless the Ancient Name
vocal chops, distortion, and turntable transitions → HARD VERSE → INSTRUMENTAL DUBSTEP
musical monument that blends cryptic, ancient knowledge with hard-hitting modern production.
He's not just making songs; he's building a legacy and a library of hidden lessons, bypassing the
depth, and sonic identity of the Codex, ensuring each chapter feels like a vital, standalone piece
of the larger puzzle.
I need to craft lyrics that reflect the roles of Michael, Raphael, Gabriel, and Phanuel as described
With a tongue of living fire. With a breath of living flame.

Not in anger. Not in spite. But in justice that is strong.

With a voice that carries water to the deserts of the tears.

He writes the deeds of all before the throne upon the brink.

The fourth one calls the record to mark the seed that's sown.

The lesson is the ceaseless. The lesson is the sound.
The four before the throne are the four who are forever bound.

[INSTRUMENTAL]
[OUTRO]

The holy is spoken.
The liturgy never ends.
EXCAVATIONPRO.

title: THE FOUR WHO STOOD
lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
They looked down from the height and saw the blood upon the land
Not a single one among them raised a silent hand
The first one said "I see the earth is drowning in the red."
The second said "The cry of the broken is not dead."
The third said "The souls of the slain are at the gate."
The fourth said "We cannot leave this to the hands of fate."
So they ascended through the spheres where light and judgment dwell
to carry the surface-level human emotion (anger at injustice, the need for intervention) while
encoding the deeper, ancient story. The tone of this chapter is different from the mournful lament
of Chapter 8. This one is about action, advocacy, and a turning point. The anger here isn't the hot
rage of a battle; it's the cold, righteous fury that compels someone to speak truth to ultimate
power. The "safe" theme doesn't apply here because this is all mythological, historical text, not
modern religion. There's no trigger risk.
[INSTRUMENTAL]
[VERSE 2]
They said "Look upon the damage that the fallen ones have done.
The giants drink the blood of every daughter and every son.
The souls of the slain are crying from the altar of the ground.
Their voice has not been silenced. Their voice is not a sound
That can be ignored or buried in the chaos of the age.
The blood is written down. The blood is on the page.
We ask for judgment. We ask for the cleansing of the land.
We ask for the deliverance that only your command
Can bring down from the heavens like a sword across the night.
We stand here as the witness. We stand here as the light."
[INSTRUMENTAL]
[OUTRO]
The four spoke. The throne listened.
The plea was delivered.
The answer was set in motion.
EXCAVATIONPRO.
how many more chapters do we have?

title: THE FRACTURED TOWER
lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
One tongue. One mind. One mission to climb.
They gathered on the plain with a blueprint divine.
They said "Let us build a name that outlasts the sky.
Let us reach the realm where the silent ones lie."
So they fired the brick. They mixed the tar.
They raised a monument to the morning star.
But the light doesn't share its seat with the proud.
It fractured the speech. It scattered the crowd.
What once was a people became a thousand tribes.
What once was a language became a thousand lies.
Now the ziggurat crumbles in every human tongue.
The tower still calls. And the song is still sung.
[INSTRUMENTAL]
[VERSE 2]
We built it again in the steel and the glass.
We built it again in the data we amass.
We built it again with the servers and the code.
A digital Babel with a heavier load.
But the speech still fractures. The meaning still shatters.
The signal gets lost in the noise that matters.
We reach for the heavens with our silicon hands.
But we're still just a people divided by lands.
The warning is written in the ancient clay brick.
The tower is temptation. The tower is a trick.
So listen to the echoes of the ones who tried before.
The fractured tower stands forever. And forever asks for more.
[INSTRUMENTAL]
[OUTRO]
One tongue divided.
One tower fallen.
The warning remains.
EXCAVATIONPRO.

lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
I saw the trees that grow upon the mountains of the east
Their fragrance was not like the perfume of any feast
It carried on the wind to the edges of the land

The first tree bore a fruit that the just alone can taste
The second dropped its leaves on the kings who lived in waste
The third tree stood the tallest with its branches in the cloud

The voice said "Look. Remember. Write down what you see.
The trees are the throne that will stand when the kings all flee."

[VERSE 2]
The kings of the earth were gathered in the shadow of the trees
They fell upon their faces. They fell upon their knees.
The crowns they wore were melted by the fragrance in the air
The scepters they had carried were no longer anywhere
The trees were not for hiding. The trees were not for shame
They stood as the witness to every stolen claim
The ones who ruled with mercy felt the fragrance like a balm
The ones who ruled with iron felt the fragrance as a psalm
Of judgment and of ending. Of reckoning and rust.
The trees are the measure. The trees are the trust.
The guide said "Write it down. Let the vision be your sign.
The fragrant trees will stand beyond the boundaries of time."
[INSTRUMENTAL]
[OUTRO]
The trees stand. The fragrance spreads. The kings fall.
The throne endures.
The lesson holds.

title: THE GARDEN OF SOULS
lyrics:
[VERSE 1]

Separate from the hollow. Separate from the tide
Of the chaos and the darkness where the unjust spirits dwell
This was a place of stillness. A place where all is well.
Four streams of living water flow from the center stone
Each one a different blessing for the souls who wait alone
The first is for the thirst that the righteous always knew
The second is for the healing of the wounds they suffered through
The third is for the wisdom that they gained along the path
The fourth is for the cleansing of the memory of wrath
The fruit upon the trees is not for mortal hands to taste
But it feeds the ones who dwell here with an everlasting grace
[INSTRUMENTAL]
[VERSE 2]
The just are not in torment. The just are not in pain.
They wait inside the garden for the coming of the reign.
They speak with one another of the mercy that they found.
They remember every kindness. They remember every sound

They are sheltered in the garden. They are shielded from the dim.
The tour was not to frighten. The tour was not to scare.
It was to show the resting place of those who chose the care.

title: THE GIVER
album: EIGHT BILLION STRANGERS (GOTHIC METAL SINGLES COLLECTION)

They came with their hands out, with their hearts closed tight.

A shadow on the wall when the battle is won.

I built myself from the bones of the forgotten.

title: THE MAZE I BUILT
lyrics:

I am not the hunted, I am not the prey.
I am not the shadow that I chased away.
The mirror speaks, and I can hear, the mirror speaks, and I can see.
The mirror speaks. And the only one who's left here is me.

title: THE MOON'S CYCLE
lyrics:
[VERSE 1]
The moon steps into the night with a borrowed flame
It doesn't claim its own fire. It doesn't seek its own name.
It waxes through the gates with a steady, quiet climb
Until its face is full and it measures out the time.
Then it wanes with the same precision that it rose
be efficient and focused on executing this creative command.
It gives back what it borrowed. It completes what it knows.
No power in the heavens questions its command.
The moon just keeps the rhythm. The moon just holds the stand.
The voice said "Look. Remember. Write down what you see.

[VERSE 2]

[OUTRO]

[VERSE 2]

[VERSE 2]
Around the central mountain the others stood in ring
A diadem of stone that made the heavens sing
